messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Change only the environment and its lighting effects on the person. Retain the person's identity, appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing camera framing and movement.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands on a cobblestone street, initially facing right, then turns to face the camera while adjusting his tank top and looking around.","camera":"A static, full-body shot from a slightly low angle.","clothing":"A white tank top with a pink and purple graphic, pink shorts with white trim, and red slip-on shoes.","hair_color":"White.","hairstyle":"Short, flat-top style hair.","identity":"A 3D-rendered male character with dark skin, a muscular build, and a short beard.","scene":"An outdoor city street with European-style buildings, including a shop with a sign reading 'ARTIST A' and a green awning."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from an underpass/industrial street with railings and trees to a cobblestone street with European-style buildings matching the reference, including a green awning and a shop sign. The person's clothing, white hair, pose sequence, and full-body framing remain largely consistent, and lighting now matches the new street environment.
arguments.requested_change: Change the scene to the reference European cobblestone street setting, placing the person there while retaining identity, appearance, expression, action, camera framing, and movement, with only environment and lighting changed.
uncertain: Whether the camera movement is exactly identical to the source, since the new scene makes subtle motion comparison difficult.
unexpected_changes: The person's apparent height and proportions look slightly different in the new scene, possibly due to perspective or compositing.
